about_the_game:
Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries

Welcome to Kip 2, a very hard precision platformer, inspired by really hard games, mostly kaizo Super Mario World hacks, such as the "Grand Poo World" or "Dram World" series.

Kip is a relentless game with countless levels, over 600 Story Mode levels that make sure Kip is tested to its limits. And if you have enough of the newer levels you can try the ones before "Story Mode" was a thing too! Be aware that as of writing this (2-12-2025) some levels can be broken, but you can skip levels thankfully, don't be scared to skip a level here and there.

Whether you are a casual or a sweat, this game provides plenty of challenge, if you have finished plenty of levels that hard variants will unlock, which are only for the most determined, thus the difficulty being really high! Almost every level has something new, from gravity changes, to all kinds of orbs that can do different things.

The game can be a bit unforgiving at times, because of the tight controls, but patience and effort will always prevail! This game is mostly for people that like old school hard games or just the hardest of the hardest platformers that are out there. The game has a steep learning curve so it's also for anyone to flex their skills, and afterwards let them try to kip it ;)

If the game has some weird hitboxes sometimes, It can happen, I'm aware of this problem, it's a little getting used to but I can't really change it because the game has been written fully with "Scratch" which isn't 'made' for games of this magnitude but I prefer working in the engine over other game engines.
detailed_description:
Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries

Welcome to Kip 2, a very hard precision platformer, inspired by really hard games, mostly kaizo Super Mario World hacks, such as the "Grand Poo World" or "Dram World" series.

Kip is a relentless game with countless levels, over 600 Story Mode levels that make sure Kip is tested to its limits. And if you have enough of the newer levels you can try the ones before "Story Mode" was a thing too! Be aware that as of writing this (2-12-2025) some levels can be broken, but you can skip levels thankfully, don't be scared to skip a level here and there.

Whether you are a casual or a sweat, this game provides plenty of challenge, if you have finished plenty of levels that hard variants will unlock, which are only for the most determined, thus the difficulty being really high! Almost every level has something new, from gravity changes, to all kinds of orbs that can do different things.

The game can be a bit unforgiving at times, because of the tight controls, but patience and effort will always prevail! This game is mostly for people that like old school hard games or just the hardest of the hardest platformers that are out there. The game has a steep learning curve so it's also for anyone to flex their skills, and afterwards let them try to kip it ;)

If the game has some weird hitboxes sometimes, It can happen, I'm aware of this problem, it's a little getting used to but I can't really change it because the game has been written fully with "Scratch" which isn't 'made' for games of this magnitude but I prefer working in the engine over other game engines.
